triggers.name: trg_sex_actual_immutable
triggers.body:
BEGIN
    IF OLD.actual_resource_command_no IS NOT NULL AND (NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_owner_no <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_owner_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_payload_schema <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_payload_schema) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_payload_hash <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_payload_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.resource_outcome_no <=> BINARY OLD.resource_outcome_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.resource_outcome_hash <=> BINARY OLD.resource_outcome_hash)) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Execution actual resource original is immutable';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.actual_resource_command_no IS NULL AND (OLD.resource_outcome_no IS NOT NULL OR OLD.resource_outcome_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_owner_no <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_owner_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_command_no <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_command_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_payload_schema <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_payload_schema) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.actual_resource_payload_hash <=> BINARY OLD.actual_resource_payload_hash) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.resource_outcome_no <=> BINARY OLD.resource_outcome_no) OR
        NOT (BINARY NEW.resource_outcome_hash <=> BINARY OLD.resource_outcome_hash)) THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'Execution initial result already exists';
    END IF;
END
